| **Summary** | Publisher-level (not journal-specific) Elsevier policy: authors may use AI writing-support tools but must disclose use, retain full accountability, and AI/LLMs cannot be listed as author. **Current positioning (what the journal accepts now):** Empirical reports, theoretical/methodological reports, brief reports, and reviews on infancy (prenatal to 36 months) covering cognitive development, emotional development, perception, perception-action coupling, prenatal development, motor development, and socialization, using behavioral, physiological, or computational methods. Journal also accepts Registered Reports and Results Masked Review article types.

**Methods noted as welcome (qualitative — not a scored 0-5 table, see Methodological Preferences below):** behavioral, physiological, computational/sensing-based, Registered Reports, Results Masked Review
